title: XR Dojo
line: AR gameplay in Unity C# and a browser port in React Three Fiber.
role: Software Engineer Intern, March 2026 to now
caption: Browser port, scripted taps.

capture.what: A browser port (React Three Fiber, Rapier) of the soccer throw mini-game from ATL Quest, which the XR Dojo team built in Unity. The port is Stephen's: the throw, scoring, levels, wind, goal detection, and the fixes for Unity's and three.js's different axes.
capture.input: Scripted taps: synthetic pointer events about 2.4 s apart. The game code is real; the input is automated.
